result.instructions: Tools for Heartland Retail, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which items are low on stock at the main location?"; "Find the customer with the email address on this order and show their last five orders."; "List the sales orders that are still pending.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Heartland Retail data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run heartlandretail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run heartlandretail_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run heartlandretail_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. heartlandretail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: heartlandretail_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected user
tools.description: Show the Heartland Retail user behind the API token, and confirm the token works. Use it first when a call returns 401 or 403. Heartland Retail: GET /api/system/whoami.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: Search the store's items (products) by text or JSON filter, with cost, price and vendor ids. Heartland Retail: GET /api/items.

query.description: Full-text search over the indexed fields, for example a name or a SKU. Partial words match from the start.

filter.description: Optional JSON object filter, for example {"active":true}. Sent as the _filter parameter.

tools.name: heartlandretail_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: Get one item by id: cost, price, financial class and primary vendor. Heartland Retail: GET /api/items/{item_id}.

item_id.description: Record id, as returned by the list tools.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_inventory_values
tools.title: List inventory values
tools.description: Show stock quantities and values, optionally grouped (for example by item_id or location_id) and filtered to one item. Heartland Retail: GET /api/inventory/values.

group.description: Group by these fields, for example ["item_id", "location_id"].

item_id.description: Record id, as returned by the list tools.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the store's locations (stores, warehouses) with their ids. Heartland Retail: GET /api/locations.

query.description: Full-text search over the indexed fields, for example a name or a SKU. Partial words match from the start.

filter.description: Optional JSON object filter, for example {"active":true}. Sent as the _filter parameter.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search customers by name, email or a JSON filter. Heartland Retail: GET /api/customers.

query.description: Full-text search over the indexed fields, for example a name or a SKU. Partial words match from the start.

filter.description: Optional JSON object filter, for example {"active":true}. Sent as the _filter parameter.

tools.name: heartlandretail_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id: name, email, default address ids, custom fields and loyalty points. Heartland Retail: GET /api/customers/{customer_id}.

customer_id.description: Record id, as returned by the list tools.

tools.name: heartlandretail_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Give a first name or a last name (or both). Returns the new customer id. Heartland Retail: POST /api/customers.

tools.name: heartlandretail_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: Change the name or email of one customer. Only the fields you give change. Heartland Retail: PUT /api/customers/{customer_id}.

customer_id.description: Record id, as returned by the list tools.
